notes.text: LOOTY presents an immersive 3D return of the Rashid Stone to Egypt as digital repatriation. La Biennale di Venezia's account of the collective's 2023 installation (https://www.labiennale.org/en/architecture/2023/mnemonic/looty) identifies Chidirim Nwaubani and Ahmed Abokor and describes their use of LiDAR, 3D rendering and blockchain tokens. The project deliberately calls this a digital heist; this record does not treat a digital surrogate as equivalent to physical restitution or establish authorisation by a source community. No MoSA object relationship is established, and no model or image is republished.
